from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-abf1d557.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next(( (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1), None)
    two = next(( (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2), None)
    if one is None or two is None:
        return out
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    ar, ac = abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)
    if ar >= ac:
        # Follow the diagonal from 1 until one column short of 2, then go straight.
        while c != tc-dc and r != tr-dr:
            r += dr
            c += dc
            if (r, c) != two and grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
        while r != tr-dr:
            r += dr
            if (r, c) != two and grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        # Follow the diagonal until one row short of 2, then go straight.
        while r != tr-dr and c != tc-dc:
            r += dr
            c += dc
            if (r, c) != two and grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
        while c != tc-dc:
            c += dc
            if (r, c) != two and grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(program_path),'exec'),globals())
print(program_path)
